title: C hal: crc32 + encode_slot/parse_slot helpers for two-slot records (bit-exact with rust lichen-hal storage.rs)
description: First slice of b7z9.11.1 (decompose-first). Pure functions only, no storage I/O: C port of rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs crc32 (reflect-8 0xEDB88320, init/max-out) and encode_slot/parse_slot (SLOT_HEADER_LEN 20: magic[4], version u8=1, reserved[3], generation u64 BE nonzero, len u32 BE; payload; crc32 trailer u32 BE). Placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/ (new file, e.g. hal_storage_redundant.c + include header). Tests: new host CTest lichen/tests/hal_storage_redundant pinning a Rust-computed CRC32 vector + encode/parse roundtrip + corrupt/truncated/generation-0/length-mismatch rejects. Update the parent 11.1 description to note this slice done.
